cta: Follow for more rights most people never use.

captions.hook_line: Paid for something that never arrived? You have a legal right to dispute it 💳
captions.body: Under the Fair Credit Billing Act, you can dispute billing errors on a credit card, including goods you paid for but did not receive, generally within 60 days of the statement that first showed the charge. Write to the issuer's billing-error address; while it investigates, you generally don't have to pay the disputed amount. Keep your records. Not legal advice.
captions.comment_prompt: Have you ever won a credit card dispute?

youtube_title: Your 60-Day Right to Dispute a Card Charge
